THE PROBLEM

Large codebases aren't hard because there's too much code.

They're hard because you don't know
where to start.

When you inherit an unfamiliar system, you end up guessing. You search randomly, skim files, ask colleagues, or just hope the docs help. Octocode changes how developers research code — with real evidence, not guesses.

some-large-project/
📁 src/
├── 📁 core/
├── scheduler.ts
├── reconciler.ts
└── fiber.ts ← where does this go?
├── 📁 hooks/
├── useEffect.ts
└── useState.ts
├── 📁 renderer/
├── dom.ts
└── native.ts
├── 📁 events/
└── SyntheticEvent.ts
└── 📁 utils/
├── invariant.ts
└── getComponentName.ts
📁 packages/ (47 more…)
— 1,247 files. Where do you start?
THE WORKSHOP

Research unfamiliar code with AI.

This is a practical, hands-on workshop. You'll work with Octocode, investigate real codebases, and learn how to approach code research more effectively.

Investigate unfamiliar code

Explore large codebases and understand how different parts connect — without reading everything.

Trace features and dependencies

Follow how behavior moves through the code — from user action to database, across layers and services.

Ask better research questions

Learn how to turn a vague question into a focused investigation that actually produces answers.

Find evidence in the code

Ground your understanding in real code instead of assumptions. Know why something works the way it does.

VIDEO

Why code research matters.

const research = await octocode.search({
  repo: 'facebook/react',
  query: 'fiber reconciler algorithm',
  strategy: 'evidence-first'
});

// 14 results with cited code evidence
research.findings.forEach(f => {
  console.log(f.evidence, f.location);
});

BEFORE YOU APPLY

10-Minute Research Challenge

Before the workshop, we'd like you to spend around 10 minutes exploring a public codebase with Octocode.

NO PREVIOUS OCTOCODE EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Choose one of the repositories below and pick a feature, component, or flow that you genuinely want to understand.

github.com
facebook/react

The library for web and native user interfaces.
github.com
vercel/next.js

The React framework for the web. Build full-stack apps.
github.com
kubernetes/kubernetes

Production-grade container scheduling and management.

Use Octocode to investigate it.

01

What were you trying to understand?

The feature, component, or flow you chose to explore.

02

What did you search for or ask Octocode?

The queries or questions you used during your research.

03

What was the most interesting finding or insight?

Something you found surprising, unexpected, or genuinely useful.

There is no single correct answer. We're interested in how you approach code research and what you find interesting.

Part 3 — Octocode Investigation Challenge

Before the workshop, we'd like you to get some hands-on experience with Octocode.

  1. 1Go to octocode.ai and install Octocode in your IDE.
  2. 2Choose one of your own projects, or a project you'd like to explore.
  3. 3Use Octocode to research a technical question related to the project.
  4. 4Use what you learned to improve, implement, or better understand something in the project.

Reflection: What project did you choose? What were you trying to understand? What did you research with Octocode, and what was the most interesting or useful finding?

There is no single correct answer. We want to see how you approach code research and what you find interesting.
